positions.name: PlaceholderContentAsSettled
positions.frame: how does minimal placeholder content present itself as settled document text?
positions.why: Both expressions are bare, present-tense, concrete assertions — a title string ('Some Other Title That Should Not Win') and a body ('Body.') — that read as placeholder or test content yet are delivered without hedging, as settled artifacts. The shared directional read is the tension between their minimal, evidently placeholder nature and their unhedged presentation as real, current content.
